equation.symbols_and_units: Dk is the cutoff disclosure set; h is a scoped history; Oi returns the observation on its declared basis; Ii has the same units; CM is the joint logical condition.
equation.assumptions_and_domain: h lies in the model universe HM; rounding follows declared metadata or an explicit assumption, and only applicable contexts are conjoined.
equation.derivation_and_status: Set comprehension defining a target, not a derived empirical equality or proof that the universe includes reality.
equation.interpretation_and_transition: No histories means model/data inconsistency; one means identification only at declared resolution; multiple preserve unresolved alternatives.
